segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאוֹמֵר לַחֲבֵירוֹ: ״חֲצִי שָׂדֶה אֲנִי מוֹכֵר לָךְ״ – מְשַׁמְּנִין בֵּינֵיהֶן, וְנוֹטֵל חֲצִי שָׂדֵהוּ. ״חֶצְיָהּ בַּדָּרוֹם אֲנִי מוֹכֵר לָךְ״ – מְשַׁמְּנִין בֵּינֵיהֶן, וְנוֹטֵל חֶצְיָהּ בַּדָּרוֹם. וְהוּא מְקַבֵּל עָלָיו מְקוֹם הַגָּדֵר, חָרִיץ וּבֶן חָרִיץ. וְכַמָּה הוּא חָרִיץ? שִׁשָּׁה טְפָחִים. וּבֶן חָרִיץ – שְׁלֹשָׁה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «If one says to another: I am selling you half a field,» without specifying which half he is selling, «an assessment is made» of the field, which is then divided «between them, and» the buyer «takes half of» the seller’s «field.» If the seller says: «I am selling you the half that is on the southern side» of the field, «an assessment is made» of the northern and the southern sides of the field, which is then divided «between them, and he takes the half on the southern side. And he accepts upon himself» to provide «the space for the fence» between the two halves of the field out of his own property. He also accepts to provide out of his own property the space for the larger «ditch and the smaller ditch,» which are meant to keep animals out of the field. «And how» wide «is» the larger «ditch? Six handbreadths. And» how wide is «the smaller ditch? Three» handbreadths.
